visual.general_description: Blink reflex recording traces for left and right supraorbital stimulation, with R1 and iR2 marked on one trace and the other responses labeled unobtainable.
visual.detailed_description: Black line recordings on a white background arranged in two columns headed Left stimulation and Right stimulation and two rows labeled L and R at the left. The upper-left trace rises to a sharp peak under a bracket labeled R1 and shows smaller waves under a bracket labeled iR2; two black arrows below the trace point to the printed times 10.0 ms and 35.3 ms. The lower-left trace is nearly flat and is labeled cR2 : unobtainable. The upper-right trace is a smooth rounded hump without discrete waves and is labeled cR2 : unobtainable. The lower-right trace is a low smooth line labeled R1, iR2 : unobtainable. A scale bar at the right reads 100μV and 10ms.
